coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .nvchecker.toml due to LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) on individual files should not cascade to 'inconclusive' for the entire package when the failed file is non-critical (e.g., metadata configs like .nvchecker.toml)
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file could not be reviewed due to tool error' and 'file reviewed and found suspicious', treating the former as a coverage gap rather than a verdict blocker
For packages with only metadata/config files beyond PKGBUILD, a successful PKGBUILD review with pinned checksums should be sufficient for a safe verdict even if auxiliary files fail to review
